squidgame.game.red_light.headline: %s contestants crossed the line
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.1: Cross the playground and reach the finish line before time runs out.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.2: While the giant doll chants with her back turned (GREEN LIGHT) you may run.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.3: When the chant ends she turns around. You have a stopping allowance of %s s to stop.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.4: When her eyes light up (RED LIGHT) any movement you cause - walking, running, jumping - eliminates you. Turning the camera is fine.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.5: If you are pushed or knocked back you are safe, as long as you are not pressing a movement key.
squidgame.game.red_light.instruction.6: Anyone who has not crossed the line when time runs out is eliminated. Difficulty: %s.
squidgame.game.red_light.objective: Reach the finish line - freeze when her eyes glow!
squidgame.game.red_light.objective.safe: You crossed the line. Wait for the others.
squidgame.game.red_light.title: Red Light, Green Light

squidgame.game.tug_of_war.headline: %s contestants survived the tug of war
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.1: Two teams pull a rope across a pit. The team whose end is pulled over the edge falls and is eliminated; the winners survive.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.2: Hold [%s] to pull: it drains your stamina, release it to recover. An exhausted contestant can only brace until their strength is back.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.3: Hold [%s] to brace: leaning back anchors your team against being dragged and costs far less stamina than pulling.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.4: Tap [%s] exactly on the beat (watch the ring): a well-timed heave is a burst of force, and the more of your team heaves together the stronger every burst. Mistimed heaves only cost stamina.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.5: Pace yourself: a team that burns its stamina early loses late. If time runs out the rope position decides; a dead tie goes to a sudden death.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.instruction.6: A heat lasts %s s. Difficulty: %s. With more than 64 contestants the field pulls in several heats.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.objective: Pull the rope over your edge - heave on the beat!
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.objective.wait: Your heat is not up yet. Watch the rope and learn the rhythm.
squidgame.game.tug_of_war.objective.won: Your team survived. Wait for the other heats.
